Increased international travel and trade, population growth and movement, greater urbanization, and insufficient attention to existing weak health systems are key drivers for the emergence of infectious diseases. STRIDES aims to increase a country’s Joint External Evaluation (JEE) scores by supporting national governments to strengthen core capacities — including laboratory and surveillance systems strengthening and emergency response operations — thereby improving compliance with International Health Regulations (IHR) and overall global health security. Position Summary: The STRengthening Infectious disease DEtection Systems (STRIDES) Bangladesh Technical Director leads and directs technical focus areas across the Activity to enhance global health security in Bangladesh. They will align STRIDES technical frameworks, approaches, tools, and activities with relevant normative guidelines and technical standards in country. Represent STRIDES at global health security-focused events echnical working group meetings; collect and share information that could be valuable to the Activity.
